assertions.claim: Empty state; exact-ID duplicate-name creation; Rocket arrow selection and Orange radio; genuine provider-disabled refusal retains draft, creates one reusable session, no model request until retry; first prompt includes amber instructions.

First Electron restart retains both Projects/transcript; tabs use arrow focus; Cancel discards draft; Save persists revised instructions; next prompt includes revised context and excludes old instructions.
Move/detach use exact IDs; project-filtered history; Search instructions and Library route exact record; sidebar child opens chat, See all opens exact project, Space collapse makes children inert.

Delete detaches Chat without transcript loss; second restart retains surviving Project and detached messages; deleted route shows unavailable; subsequent prompt excludes all prior Project context; page/console errors empty.

Real completed IPC responses delayed, not replaced: duplicate pending saves refused; newer draft retained; stale-owner writes/reads isolated; browser Back/Forward correct; real validation refusal retains draft; Library source-read failure offers successful Retry; page/console errors empty.
